title: Jacob's Ladder: Where Can I Learn More About DFT and Functionals?

rung_help.mGGA: + kinetic-energy density τ (or the Laplacian), no exact exchange
rung_help.H-GGA: GGA + a fraction of Hartree–Fock exchange
rung_help.H-mGGA: meta-GGA + a fraction of Hartree–Fock exchange

ladder.name: SPW92
ladder.why: Slater exchange plus Perdew–Wang 1992 correlation. It depends only on the local spin density.

ladder.name: SVWN5
ladder.why: Slater exchange plus Vosko–Wilk–Nusair (form V) correlation, again only the local density.

ladder.name: BP86
ladder.why: Becke 88 exchange and Perdew 86 correlation both use the density gradient.

ladder.name: BLYP
ladder.why: Becke 88 exchange plus Lee–Yang–Parr correlation, a pure GGA with no exact exchange.

ladder.name: PBE
ladder.why: The non-empirical Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof GGA.

ladder.name: M06-L
ladder.why: A local Minnesota functional that uses the kinetic-energy density τ, with no Hartree–Fock exchange.

ladder.name: M11-L
ladder.why: A dual-range *local* meta-GGA. Range separation here does not mean exact exchange.

ladder.name: MN15-L
ladder.why: A local meta-NGA (non-separable gradient approximation). On this simplified ladder it sits on the meta-GGA rung, with no exact exchange.

ladder.name: SCAN
ladder.why: The “strongly constrained and appropriately normed” meta-GGA, built to satisfy 17 exact constraints.

ladder.name: B97M-V
ladder.why: A meta-GGA with VV10 nonlocal correlation but no Hartree–Fock exchange.

ladder.name: B3LYP
ladder.why: A three-parameter hybrid with 20% Hartree–Fock exchange.

ladder.name: B3PW91
ladder.why: Becke’s original three-parameter hybrid (20% HF exchange) with PW91 correlation.

ladder.name: M05-2X
ladder.why: A hybrid meta-GGA with 56% Hartree–Fock exchange.

ladder.name: M06
ladder.why: A hybrid meta-GGA with 27% Hartree–Fock exchange.

ladder.name: M06-2X
ladder.why: A hybrid meta-GGA with 54% Hartree–Fock exchange (“2X” = double the exchange of M06).

ladder.name: M06-HF
ladder.why: A hybrid meta-GGA with 100% Hartree–Fock exchange.

ladder.name: M11
ladder.why: A range-separated hybrid meta-GGA: 42.8% HF exchange at short range, rising to 100% at long range.

ladder.name: MN15
ladder.why: A hybrid meta-NGA with 44% Hartree–Fock exchange.

ladder.name: PBE0
ladder.why: PBE with 25% Hartree–Fock exchange.

ladder.name: ωB97M-V
ladder.why: A range-separated hybrid meta-GGA with VV10 nonlocal correlation.
